Watch Parandhu Sella Vaa from O Kadhal Kanmani sung by Karthik & Shashaa Tirupati. Vairamuthu’s lyrics & a groovy tune give this song a fun feel, sure to make it a favourite.
Song Name - Parandhu Sella Vaa
Movie - O Kadhal Kanmani
Singer - Karthik & Shashaa Tirupati
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Vairamuthu
Director - Mani Ratnam
Starring - Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menen
